notes: Canal corridor: the Miami canal runs N-S at x ~2603-2755 (printed 41 ft) between West Plum Street (west roadway, printed '(W. PLUM)', 55 ft, centre x ~2508-2520) and East Plum Street (east roadway, printed 'E. PLUM', centre x ~2846-2858); the whole corridor is overprinted 'CENTRAL PARKWAY' and the 1200-block addresses on the west side are labelled Central Parkway (later correction). Between y ~3412 and ~4270 the canal is pasted over and the full corridor is printed 149 ft (Central Parkway). Cross streets were recorded as T's onto the roadway on their own side: West 14th meets W. Plum (y 513) and E. Plum (y 493) on either side of a FOOT BRIDGE (x 2572-2799, y ~500); West 12th meets both roadways in line (y 3466 / 3462); the canal crossing is hidden under the pasted parkway strip here but sheet 65 shows an IRON BRIDGE, so both are marked cross; Charles meets W. Plum at y 4305 and its in-line continuation east of the canal meets E. Plum at y 4287 (name not printed east of the canal; taken as Charles). West 14th east of the canal and Grant are printed only east of E. Plum ('GRANT'); the 14th leg there carries only '6" W.P.'. Betts (40 ft, measured), Hopkins, Clark and Chestnut come in from sheet 63 on the west of Central only; West 14th, Laurel (east leg), Ann, West 12th and Charles leave Central to the east. Laurel jogs at Central: west leg y 1251 (~54 ft between lines), east leg y 1203 (printed 36 ft near Central, 30 ft near W. Plum). West 14th printed 40 ft; Ann 40 ft; West 12th 60 ft; Charles 40 ft; Central 60 ft.
